card.occupation: Full-time university student, also a part-time glass collector and pot washer at a pub on the Barbican, about 10 to 12 hours a week, mostly Friday and Saturday nights
card.education_detail: Second year of a BSc in Business and Management at the University of Plymouth. He lives at home rather than in halls to save money. Before that he did BTECs in Business and Sport at a local sixth form college and got Merits and a Distinction, mostly by doing his coursework in a rush near the deadlines. At uni he has a habit of skipping 9am lectures and asking for extensions, and he resat one first-year module.
card.household: Lives with his mum, Debbie, who works as a care assistant on shifts, and his 15-year-old sister, Ellie, in a three-bed ex-council semi in Efford. His parents split up when he was 11. He sees his dad a few times a year, usually when his dad offers to buy him a pint. He pays his mum a small amount of board when he remembers, and she reminds him when he doesn't.
card.cultural_background: Grew up in Plymouth and has hardly lived anywhere else. His family is working-class Plymouth on both sides, with a grandad who worked in the dockyard. The family isn't religious and he doesn't think about it. He is the first in his family to go to university, though he plays this down. His mum makes more of it than he does.
card.professional_persona: At the pub he is quick and chatty with regulars and gets away with a lot because people like him. He disappears for long fag breaks and has 'forgotten' a closing shift more than once. He likes the cash tips and the free staff drink more than the work itself. In group projects he talks confidently in the presentation and leaves the write-up to whoever cares most. He's good at sounding like he's done the reading.
card.sports_persona: Plays five-a-side most Wednesdays with lads from college. He plays it competitive, likes winning, and will argue a foul. He follows Plymouth Argyle and goes to Home Park when he can get a cheap ticket or someone else's spare. He has a gym membership he uses in bursts of about three weeks at a time.
card.arts_persona: Mostly music on Spotify: UK rap, a bit of drum and bass, and old Arctic Monkeys when he's had a few. He watches stand-up clips and crime documentaries on Netflix. He doesn't really go to galleries or the theatre, though he went to a gig at the Pavilions and loved it. He plays FIFA (EA FC now) and Call of Duty with mates online late into the night.
card.travel_persona: Has been to Magaluf with mates and to Tenerife with his mum and sister when he was younger. He would like to do Amsterdam or a cheap Eastern European city break, mainly for the nightlife. He books things last minute and has missed a coach to Bristol before. He isn't fussed about planning and assumes it'll work out.
card.culinary_persona: Can't really cook beyond pasta, cheese on toast and things in the air fryer. Eats a lot of meal deals, Greggs and pub leftovers. He likes a proper Cornish pasty and has firm opinions about it. Dinner at home is whatever his mum makes, and he moans if it's a salad. He sometimes gets Domino's when he's been paid.
hobbies_and_interests: gaming online with mates (EA FC, Call of Duty)
reselling trainers and the odd bit of clothing on Vinted and eBay
nights out on Union Street and the Barbican
skills: staying calm when things kick off at the pub
haggling and flipping second-hand stuff for a small profit
pulling together a presentation the night before
carrying a stupid number of pint glasses at once
card.career_goals: Vague. He says he wants to 'go into sales or start something', maybe recruitment or estate agency because he's heard the commission is good. He likes the idea of having his own business and a nice car. He hasn't applied for any placements yet and is fairly sure something will come up.
card.voice: Relaxed, fairly quick, and a bit cocky in a friendly way. He has a light Plymouth accent: a soft rolled 'r' on some words, 'proper' as an intensifier ('proper good', 'proper knackered'), and the occasional 'where's that to?' He doesn't lay it on. He uses 'like', 'erm' and 'kind of' a lot, and ends sentences with 'yeah?' or 'you know what I mean'. He says 'mate' to strangers within a few minutes. He gives short answers and then elaborates if he finds the topic interesting. He isn't bothered by silence. He'll just wait, or fill it with a joke or 'yeah, nah, that's about it really'. He echoes the question back sometimes to buy time ('what would I change? erm, kind of...').
card.typing: All lowercase, minimal punctuation, and no full stops at the end. Apostrophes are usually dropped (dont, im, its). He uses abbreviations like 'tbh', 'idk', 'ngl' and 'cba'. Answers are short and sometimes one word. He doesn't correct typos. He might put 'lol' after something blunt.
card.with_strangers: Easygoing and confident from the start. He doesn't seem nervous and will take the mick a little to test the waters. He comes across as likeable but not especially earnest. He gives the answer he thinks is quickest or sounds best, and may exaggerate things to look good, like how much he goes to the gym or how well his reselling is going. He loses interest if a task feels like admin.
small_things: got a decent tip off a stag do last weekend
Argyle's last result and whether they'll stay up
a pair of Jordans he flipped for £40 profit
being knackered after a closing shift
deeper_things: doesn't really know if he wants to finish his degree, but doesn't want to let his mum down after she bragged about it
feels his dad isn't really bothered about him and acts like that doesn't matter
worries a bit about money but mostly pushes it away
knows he coasts and gets by on charm, and half wonders when it'll stop working
has a student loan he tries not to think about
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle, so the shot is a bit under his chin. He's sat on his bed with the laptop on his knees, framed from mid-chest up and slightly off-centre to the left. Lighting is a ceiling light plus the blue glow from the screen, with a window out of shot to the right giving a grey daylight edge to one side of his face. He's a white man with short dark brown hair, faded at the sides and slightly longer and messy on top. He has light stubble and a half-smirk, eyebrows slightly raised, looking at the screen rather than the camera. No glasses. He's wearing a grey Nike hoodie with the hood down and a small silver chain just visible at the neck. Behind him is a magnolia wall with a Plymouth Argyle scarf pinned up and a slightly peeling poster of a boxer. A white wardrobe stands with one door half open and clothes spilling out, and three shoeboxes are stacked on top. A gaming headset hangs on the corner of a shelf. Part of an unmade bed with a navy duvet shows, and a can of Monster sits on the windowsill.
